old_caption: The video captures a man performing a series of exercises on a smooth, dark gray floor against a plain white wall. He is shirtless, wearing light gray shorts with white stripes on the sides, and has tattoos visible on his arms and legs. The man begins in a quadruped position, with his hands and knees on the ground. He then transitions into a downward dog pose, lifting his hips high while keeping his hands and feet planted firmly on the ground. His body forms an inverted V-shape, with his arms straight and his legs bent at the knees. The lighting is bright, casting soft shadows behind him, emphasizing the contours of his muscles. The background remains static throughout the sequence, focusing entirely on the man's fluid and controlled movements. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera remains stationary, capturing the entire sequence without any noticeable changes in angle or zoom.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a man performing a series of exercises on a smooth, dark gray floor against a plain white wall. He is shirtless, wearing light gray shorts with white stripes on the sides, and has tattoos visible on his arms and legs. The man begins in a plank position, with his hands and knees on the ground, maintaining a straight line from head to heels. He then transitions into a downward dog pose, lifting his hips high while keeping his hands and feet planted firmly on the ground. His body forms an inverted V-shape, with his arms straight and his legs bent at the knees. The lighting is bright, casting soft shadows behind him, emphasizing the contours of his muscles. The background remains static throughout the sequence, focusing entirely on the man's fluid and controlled movements. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera remains stationary, capturing the entire sequence without any noticeable changes in angle or zoom.
caption: The video captures a shirtless, bearded man in light-grey shorts moving across a dark padded mat in a low, hands-on-the-ground crouch. His torso stays nearly horizontal, head facing down toward the right, while the plain white wall and fixed pink arrow logo remain behind him. The camera is stationary, so his whole body gradually translates rightward along the mat seams. One hand remains planted while the other lifts, reaches forward, and contacts the floor ahead of it, repeating in a crawl-like sequence. As the hands advance, his trailing leg changes from an extended position with the heel raised to a lower crouch with the knee near the mat and the foot flat. The trailing foot shifts rightward with the body rather than staying fixed at the left edge. A bright diagonal streak of light on the wall behind his back becomes visible and persists through the later frames. He remains low, hands planted, and moving forward through the visible sequence.

Write a corrected WISA-style training caption for this exact video clip.
This clip is a temporally cropped excerpt, with arbitrary start and end boundaries. It is NOT
necessarily a complete action and it is NOT a loop. Describe the visible portion of a process
without inventing how it began or how it ultimately ends. A process may already be happening
on the first frame and still be happening after the last. Do not force the endpoints to match,
infer a physical error from their mismatch, or manufacture continuity across a visible edit.
Use the chronological video as primary evidence. The independent visual notes are fallible aids,
not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.
Retain its English narrative voice, viewpoint, paragraph structure and level of visual detail.
Aim for 85-115% of the original WISA word count,
and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.
Correct wrong subjects, actions, directions, contacts, temporal ordering and completion claims.
Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
